title: PR#69 MECHANISM CRACKED + LEAPFROG QUESTION ANSWERED: Hailey Collet's 0.8747729897 is a TWO-STAGE 'return' chain (PR67 -> intermediate C30 0.8747759 -> final 0.8747729897) built on the same comparison-family template (c/h/kappa/ell/x/y, old/new capacity min-edges, 6-edge conductor, 301-node finite source DAG induction); all constants extracted from her frozen head ac76d5ef in exact rational arithmetic; the LEAPFROG ANSWER: NO short-term leapfrog of her claim exists in the visible structure: (1) OFFSET-IN-FROZEN-DATA at the NAMED-MARGIN layer is large, not small: with h/B/lambda frozen, a pure c-offset is admitted up to delta_c* = 507914723825573/2400000000000000000 = 2.116311e-4 (binding named margin: small_width_shortening 4.2321e-3 with c-slope -16/dp; next: physical_width_lower 6.67e-4, floor 1.124e-3), i.e. the named-margin ceiling is theta* = 2098947260556174427/2400000000000000000 = 0.8745613585650727 - a 2.116e-4 descent band below her claim. BUT the generated certificate layer (her 437,002 lines of Bernstein/interval tables over the 301-node DAG) is NOT re-discharged at the offset (0144 precedent), so no claim beyond 0.8747729897 follows from our side - the offset must be regenerated by the generator's owner. Her claim is NOT at her family's corner; the next race cycle plausibly lands in [0.874561, 0.874773); (2) the engine is INPUT-UNIFORM (seed step licensed for every beta in [0.51, 0.87481891] = (1+seedK/6)/2) so feeding [Z78G] 0.8748087 instead of PR67 0.874817065 changes the LICENSE MARGIN (3.69e-6 -> 2.042e-5 in kappa units) but NOT the output - input benefit does not propagate; (3) same-shape iteration is bounded by the sub-reserve scale, <= ~5e-8 theta. A meaningful leapfrog (>=1e-5 descent, i.e. below ~0.87476) requires a NEW STRUCTURAL CYCLE (new family shape), confirming the 0141/0144/0145 forecast at the new frontier. Independent replay of her full 6474-module cone (3547 record + 2927 vendored OAI baseline, tracker-pinned mathlib d13f23b, Lean 4.34.1, snapshot-guarded tarball sha 8607635a) is RUNNING in the background (tmp/b6audit/collet69/replay/) and will be the first full audit of the pending claim, ahead of the tracker's protected verification.
body:
## What was done

Answered the owner's 'can we leapfrog anything?' by pulling the frozen PR#69 head (tarball sha256 8607635a68655484206cb12112605b2734401860d2a597367b5f2cb8b54c5219, 282MB, 18118 Lean files) and reading the load-bearing structure of Hailey Collet's record hailey-collet-1252270103 in exact rational arithmetic.

## The mechanism (from her source, all values exact)

Chain: [Z78T] PR67 (0.874817065 = 174963413/200000000) -> SEED+INTERMEDIATE stage (namespace Record1252270103Return.C30) theta_1 = 8747759/10^7 = 0.8747759 -> FINAL stage (namespace Record1252270103Finite) theta_2 = 8747729897/10^10 = 0.8747729897.

Endpoints (submissions/hailey-collet-1252270103/src/Submissions/hailey_collet_1252270103/Record1252270103Source/Core/Endpoint.lean):
- seed_step : SeedStep ; nf_step : NFStep
- beta_bound : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta <= 8747729897/10000000000
- hecke_nonvanishing / dirichlet_nonvanishing (pole exclusion) / zeta_nonvanishing (riemannZeta - the SAME mathlib object; the vendored OAI framework cites mathlib's riemannZeta_one_ne_zero, so the same-object pin-equivalence gate passes in advance)
- the file ships its own #print axioms lines for all six declarations

Step contracts (Record1252270103Graph/GraphContract.lean):
- seedK = 112445673/25000000 ; finalK = 11243277/2500000
- SeedStep / NFStep each assume 51/100 <= beta AND 6*(2*beta-1) <= K respectively - the INCUMBENT enters only through this license inequality; the step proof is uniform in beta over the whole licensed range.
- FiniteInduction.lean: an explicitly selected DAG of source001..source301 nodes (the PR body's '64 seed source faces + 221 derived source faces'), each node carrying SourceValid + NFAccounting (two exact fee schedules: 1e-12/1e-8/1e-7 and 1e-17/1e-12/1e-10), composing to four global suppliers (two for the C30 intermediate, two for the final return).

Calibration (exact, from C30/ReturnConstants.lean and Finite/ReturnConstants.lean):
- intermediate: c1 = 1252241/10^7, kappa1 = 1-2*c1 = 3747759/5000000, theta1 = (1+kappa1)/2 = 8747759/10^7; license ceiling cap1 = seedK/6 = 0.74963782; calibration gap gamma1 = cap1 - kappa1 = 4301/5e7 = 8.602e-5.
- final: c2 = 1252270103/10^10, kappa2 = 3747729897/5e9, theta2 = (1+kappa2)/2 = 8747729897/10^10; license ceiling cap2 = finalK/6 = kappa1 EXACTLY (zero license waste: the final stage is licensed precisely at the intermediate's output); calibration gap gamma2 = cap2 - kappa2 = 29103/5e9 = 5.8206e-6 - exactly her named reserve_incumbent.

Gain law (exact): stage gain in kappa = gamma_j - margin_j, where margin_j is the input's distance below the license ceiling. g1 (PR67 input): margin_1 = cap1 - (2*0.874817065-1) = 3.69e-6, gain_1 = 8.233e-5 (kappa) = 4.1165e-5 (theta). g2: margin_2 = 0, gain_2 = 5.8206e-6 (kappa) = 2.9103e-6 (theta). Total PR67 -> claim: 4.4075e-5 in theta.

Named reserve ladder of the final record (all 33 named reserves of Record1252270103Finite/ReturnConstants.lean, exact): incumbent 29103/5e9 = 5.8206e-6 (= cap2 - kappa2 = the realized gain exactly), large_shift 5.2283e-5, principal_z 8.3502e-5, kink_before_top 8.9442e-4, short_plain_shortening 1.7663e-3, physical_width_upper 2.9999e-3, physical_width_lower 4.0749e-3, small_width_shortening 4.2321e-3, floor 4.2581e-3, prime_supply 9.4420e-3, physical_plain_lower 1.0054e-2, source_C_cap 1.0999e-2, conductor_switch_before_kink 1.1080e-2, source_P_cap 1.1999e-2, physical_plain_upper 1.8616e-2, principal_w 2.1197e-2, holomorphic_box 2.4773e-2, Gram_ell_below_one_fifth 3.2425e-2, source_intercept 3.2610e-2, feedback_y 3.5048e-2, small_row 3.7492e-2, feedback_kappa 4.9546e-2 (= kappa2 - 7/10 exactly, verified), capacity_domain 6.4901e-2, Gram_y_above_x 9.7478e-2, Gram_2x_above_y_plus_ell 1.0242e-1, conductor_top_before_twoy 1.2980e-1, feedback_d 1.9990e-1, Gram_x_above_ell 1.9990e-1, source_lambda 2.7308e-1, conductor_peak_before_switch 3.2317e-1, large_shift_clipped 3.4524e-1, small_shift_cost 3.4524e-1, conductor_small_before_peak 4.5995e-1. The intermediate (C30) record has its own 33-reserve list of the same shape (its smallest are ~1e-5..1e-4 scale, its conductor peak->switch is 3.229e-1).

## The leapfrog verdict (exact)

1. OFFSET-IN-FROZEN-DATA (named-margin layer): the two sub-margins people would guess at (large_shift 5.2283e-5, principal_z 8.3502e-5) are c-CONSTANT (they depend on B/lambda/h only) and do NOT bind the c-offset at all. Deriving the exact c-derivative of all 33 named margins at her constants (h/B/lambda frozen): the binding shrinker is small_width_shortening (margin 507914723825573/120015144270000000 = 4.2321e-3, c-slope -16/dp = -80000000000/4000504809 = -19.99748), giving delta_c* = 507914723825573/2400000000000000000 = 2.116311e-4 exactly. Runner-ups: physical_width_lower headroom 6.67e-4, floor 1.124e-3, conductor_switch_before_kink 2.17e-2. My margin formulas reproduce her 33 reserve_*_exact rationals to the digit, so the derivative analysis is on the right equations. The generated certificate layer at the offset remains the 0144-type pending re-discharge: the named-margin layer CLEARS, but a claimable bound requires re-running her generator/certificate pipeline at the deeper c.
2. INPUT SWAP (our [Z78G] 0.8748087 instead of PR67): no. SeedStep is uniform in beta for every beta in [0.51, (1+seedK/6)/2 = 0.87481891]; [Z78G] is licensed (margin 2.042e-5 in kappa vs 3.69e-6 for PR67) but the INTERMEDIATE OUTPUT IS IDENTICAL (theta1 = 0.8747759 regardless of input) and so is the final. Her claimed step is reproducible from our in-tree input, but the output cannot be bettered by swapping inputs. This kills the 'her engine, our better input' leapfrog hypothesis explicitly and exactly.
3. SAME-SHAPE ITERATION: the visible structure does NOT require a brand-new mechanism for the next 1e-4 of descent - it may be a deeper-c re-run of her own generator (re-certifying the Bernstein layer), plausibly landing in [0.874561, 0.874773). Beyond the named-margin ceiling theta* = 0.8745613585650727, fresh structure (new h/B/lambda co-optimization or new family shape) is required.
4. MEANINGFUL LEAPFROG OF HER CLAIM BY OUR OWN RECORD: not available to us - any claim beyond 0.8747729897 needs re-certification of her generated layer (generator + certificate tables), which belongs to the tracker race. Our contribution is verification (replay, in progress), this ceiling analysis, and in-tree adoption on merge. The 0141/0144/0145 forecast is refined: the just-shipped record sits 2.1e-4 ABOVE its own family's named-margin corner - the next cycle is plausibly an offset of the same shape, and the structural frontier (new shape) is what bounds the total race.

## Independent replay (launched 2026-10-21, in progress)

- staging: tmp/b6audit/collet69/replay/ (compute_order.py, compile_candidates.py, stageD/{Solution.lean,axiomprobe.lean}, stageD_runner.sh)
- scope: 6474 modules = 3547 (her record, Submissions.hailey_collet_1252270103.*) + 2927 (vendored OAI baseline + framework, Submissions.openai_baseline.*), the submission-local Candidate.* trees pruned (collide across submissions; not in her proof cone - 0 Candidate.* imports verified)
- deps: reused tracker-pinned .lake tree (mathlib d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612, identical to the verified [Z78G] replay of 0134/0142; the PR is 437,002 additions / 0 deletions so no pin changed); Lean 4.34.1 (pins.json: leanprover/lean4:v4.34.1)
- snapshot guard: tarball sha256 must equal 8607635a...
- stage D plan: D1 canonical statements at 8747729897/10^10 in BOTH scopes (zeta_nonvanishing + dirichlet_nonvanishing) compile against the replayed cone; D2 axiom cone via #print axioms (expect exactly propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound, no sorry axioms); D3 static sorry sweep over her 3547 modules.
- First-run lesson: PATH 'lean' is 4.35.0 and does NOT read the v4.34.1 olean headers ('incompatible header') - stage C relaunch pins LEAN_BIN to the 4.34.1 toolchain explicitly. Recorded so the watcher/adoption runbook pins the binary, not the name.

## Offset-ceiling computation (this session, exact rational arithmetic)

All 33 reserve definitions of Record1252270103Finite/ReturnConstants.lean were differentiated at her constants (c2, h, B, lambda frozen except c):
- c-independent margins (do not bind any c-offset): Gram_x_above_ell, physical_width_upper, short_plain_shortening, large_shift (5.2283e-5), large_shift_clipped, small_shift_cost, feedback_d, principal_z (8.3502e-5), source_* (4).
- growing with c (margin increases as c grows): Gram_2x_above_y_plus_ell, conductor_kink_before_top, physical_plain_lower, prime_supply, incumbent, feedback_y.
- shrinking with c, headroom-sorted (exact, all verified against her reserve_*_exact rationals): small_width_shortening 2.116311e-4 (BINDING; margin 4.2321e-3, |slope| 19.9975), physical_width_lower 6.669568e-4, floor 1.364767e-3, physical_plain_upper 1.861834e-3, Gram_ell_below_one_fifth 8.106323e-3, conductor_top_before_twoy 8.112633e-3, capacity_domain 8.112633e-3, Gram_y_above_x 8.123150e-3, small_row 9.372902e-3, conductor_switch_before_kink 2.167202e-2, feedback_kappa 2.477299e-2, holomorphic_box 2.477299e-2, principal_w 5.299369e-2, conductor_small_before_peak 5.749394e-2, conductor_peak_before_switch 6.167514e-2.
Max pure-c claim at the named-margin layer: theta* = 1 - (c2 + delta_c*) = 2098947260556174427/2400000000000000000 = 0.8745613585650727.

## Position and next

- PR#69 remains WATCH (draft, verification pending, paper 404) - 0146 stands. This unit adds the MECHANISM + CEILING picture: the claim sits 2.116e-4 above its family's named-margin corner, the engine is input-uniform, and no leapfrog beyond her claim is available to us without her generator's re-certification. If the replay passes, in-tree adoption (Z78Collet module, colletUpper = 8747729897/10^10, colletD0max = 3747729897/10^10, Part B16 endpoint restatement, hOffC face) is ready to run the moment the PR merges; if the replay fails, the record is voided on the B6 integrity gate (0138/PR#52 precedent). The ceiling band [0.874561, 0.874773) is now the pending next-cycle target for the tracker race (hers or a competitor re-running the generator at deeper c).
- No in-tree change from this unit. No RH claim anywhere. No adoption: provenance must first be verified by the running replay.
